notablePrerequisites: Tolsimir does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Tolsmir Wolfblood by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Voja legendary creature token.
If you control two or more Voja tokens, put one of them into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Voja token enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
